english.note: Use this all-purpose noun for the look on someone’s face that shows an emotion.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 biu2 cing4 hou2 gaau2 siu3

english.note: Use this when the mien specifically means a facial expression rather than a person's general bearing or attitude.

exampleSentences.english: When they heard the news, their mien immediately became very serious.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢一聽到個消息，表情即刻變得好凝重。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1 biu2 cing4 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 hou2 jing4 zung6

english.note: Use 表情 for a neutral description of a facial expression, rather than specifically an eye-based look.

exampleSentences.english: They had a really awkward look after hearing that.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢聽到呢句嘢之後，表情好尷尬。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 ting1 dou2 ni1 geoi3 je5 zi1 hau6 biu2 cing4 hou2 gaam1 gaai3

english.note: Use this for a particular facial expression, including a sad, displeased, or distorted expression.

exampleSentences.english: As soon as they heard the news, their face immediately became very strange.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢一聽到個消息，個表情即刻變得好古怪。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1 go3 biu2 cing4 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 hou2 gu2 gwaai3
